annotations.title: In consummation of the tabernacle.
annotations.text: The seuentie Interpreters testifie by adding this title, [1]that king Dauid made this Psalme (as he did also some others) when the Arke of God was brought into the tabernacle, [2]which he had pitched for it in Sion. 2. Reg. 6. 1. Paral. 16. VVherin he saw by prophetical spirite, and here vttereth other farre greater mysteries, & more excellent benefites, brought into the world by Christ, and preached by him, and his Apostles, then agreed to the Arke, or the time of the old Testament; but are verified in the admirable fruite of innumerable people of al nations, and of manie great Potentates conuerted to Christianitie.

notes.text: Mysteries of the Catholique Church prophecied in this Psalme.
